Swear,Ⓒv. i.ⒹSap 1, 4 U, SapaTaM Sap.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹSap c., SapaTaM grah c.
Ⓝ[Swear]er,Ⓒs.ⒹSapaTakft m.
Ⓝ[Swear]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹSapaTaM, SApaH.

Sweat,Ⓒv. i.Ⓓpra-, svid 4 P; See Perspire,
Ⓑ
 2 pariSram 4 P; tam 4 P (tire).
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓsvid c.
Ⓔs.ⒹsvedaH, GarmaH, svedajalaM.
Ⓑ
 2 pari-SramaH, AyAsaH; ‘by the s(weat) of thy brow’ AtmanaH pariSrameRa.
Ⓝ[Sweat]ing, [Sweat]y,Ⓒa.Ⓓsasveda, Garmalipta, svedavat.

Sweep,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓmfj 2 P or c., saM-pari-pra-° ‘s(weep) away’ ava-apa-mfj, apavah c., (rayeRa) apanI; ‘s(weep) across’, ‘s(weep) over’ javena Atikram 1 U, 4 P or ati-i 2 P,
Ⓔs.ⒹprasaraH, gocaraH, vizayaH; See Range.
Ⓝ[Sweep]er,Ⓒs.ⒹsaMmArjakaH, KalapUH, bahukaraH
Ⓝ[Sweep]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹsaM-, mArjanaM-nA, malApaharaRaM.
Ⓝ[Sweep]ings,Ⓒs.ⒹavakaraH, ava(pa)skaraH, malaM, saMkaraH, ucCizwaM.

Sweet,Ⓒa.ⒹmaDura; mizwa, Surasa, svAdu, maDumaya (yI f.), (of taste only).
Ⓑ
 2 cAru, maMjula, lalita, komala, manojYa; See Pleasant. ‘s(weet) smile’ cAru-maDura-smita; ‘s(weet) song’ cArugItaM, &c.
Ⓔs.ⒹmaDu n., mizwaM, AsvAdaH.
Ⓑ
 2 suKaM, sOKyaM; ‘s(weet)s of royalty’ rAjya-suKAni; ‘s(weet)-heart’ vallaBa, praRayin, dayita, kAMta, ramaRa (RI f.), priyatama; ‘s(weet)-meat’ [] mizwAnnaM, modakaH, vAyanaM; ‘s(weet)-smelling’ sugaMDi, suraBi; ‘s(weet)-speaking, -toned, -voiced’ maMjulasvana, cAruBAzin, priyaMvada, maDuravAk.
Ⓝ[Sweet]en,Ⓒv. t.ⒹmaDurIkf 8 U, mizwIkf svAdUkf.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹmaDurIBU.
Ⓝ[Sweet]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹmaDuraM, cAru, maDura in comp.; ‘smiling s(weetly)’ cAruhAsin.
Ⓝ[Sweet]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹmADuryaM, svAdutA, &c.

Swell,Ⓒv. i.ⒹSvi 1 P or pass., pra-ut-°, sPAy 1 A, vfD 1 A, utsfp 1 P; pra-upa-ci pass., bahulI-BU 1 P; ‘a heart s(well)ing with joy’ harzotPullaM hfdayaM; See Increase.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹSvi c., sPAy c. (sPAvayati), vfD c. (with air), ud-pra-A-DmA 1 P; See Puff.
Ⓝ[Swell]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹsPIti f., vfdDi f., upa cayaH.
Ⓑ
 2 SvayaTuH; SoTaH; SoPaH, gaMqaH.
Ⓑ
 3 (Of the sea) UrmipraloWanaM, saMkzoBaH.
Ⓔa.ⒹSUyamAna, utsarpin; ‘a s(welling) sea’ pracaladUrmimAlAkula.
ⓃSwollen,Ⓒa.ⒹSUna, sPIta, pravfdDa, &c.
Swelter,Ⓒv. i.ⒹGarmeRa aBiBU or bAD pass.

Swerve,Ⓒv. i.Ⓓpra-vi-cal 1 P, BraMS 4 P, 1 A, parANmuKIBU 1 P, cyu 1 A, vyati-i 2 P, vyatikram 1 U, 4 P, (with abl.); aticar 1 P, ati-vft 1 A (with acc.); See Deviate; ‘s(werv)ing from the right path’ sanmArgaBrazwa, &c.
